units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 1:5:3">Y. Bicc. I, 64ᵃ</cite> <he>וכהנים נהגו ס׳ בעצמן</he> but the priests decided to guard their dignity (by abstaining from marrying one both of whose parents were proselytes); <cite ref="Kiddushin 78b:5">Kidd. 78ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 30b:15">Bekh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>נהגו … ס׳ … שאין וכ׳</he> the priests guarding their dignity decided not to entrust matters of levitical cleanness to everybody.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 4:2:5">Y. Shek. IV, 48ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מעלה … ס׳ הוא בפרה</he> prominence was to be given, solemnity was to be given to the ceremonies connected with the preparation of the ashes of the red cow; Y. Ab. Zar. II, beg. 40ᶜ; Pesik. Par., p. 40ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 14:1">Pesik. R. s. 14</cite> <he>משום ס׳ פרה</he> in order to lend solemnity to &c.
Naz. 3ᵃ (ref. to מסלסל, ib. I, 1) ממאי דהדין ס׳ שערא הוא how do we know that this m’salsel means the curling of the hair?, v. next w.
